info.title: Payment Guard — pre-send risk check for AI agents that move money
info.description: Before an AI agent sends funds (x402 / crypto / a payment URL), check the recipient: is the address OFAC-sanctioned, on a scam/abuse blocklist, or suspicious (brand-new/unused, a contract)? Vet the payment URL for lookalikes and new domains. Resolve and screen ENS names. Deterministic, no LLM. Free data: OFAC SDN crypto addresses, ethereum-lists + ScamSniffer blocklists, on-chain reads via public RPC, ENS. On-chain checks run on Ethereum, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum and Optimism. Sanctions coverage: OFAC lists addresses by currency rather than chain, so this API ingests every EVM-format list (ETH, ARB, BSC, ETC, USDC, USDT) and matches the union, which applies to all EVM chains. Non-EVM sanctioned addresses (Bitcoin, Tron, Solana, Monero and others) are not checked because only EVM addresses are accepted. Every sanctions response carries a coverage object stating this.
